en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large historic complex enclosing an open courtyard. The buildings have steep gabled roofs, decorative façades and dormer windows in a Renaissance/Baroque style. A central gateway arch is visible in the middle building, with a leafless tree dominating the courtyard. On the right stands a clock tower with a domed top and spire. At the lower left of the image, white cursive German text identifies the location as a riding and driving school in Wermsdorf.
